Entry Level Business Analyst, Copperline Insurance (fictional company for testing)
Location: Sacramento, CA, onsite 5 days a week.
Pay: 52,000 to 60,000 dollars a year.
Great first job for recent grads!
Requirements: bachelor's degree; 3+ years of experience required in business analysis or insurance operations; advanced Excel.
Process: phone screen, Excel assessment (no outside tools or AI allowed), onsite interview.
